comments.text: You should do a video about how they make appliances to break after a few years and the cost to repair them is more than the cost to replace. Basically appliances like dishwashers, washer and dryer, etc…are disposable now.

comments.text: 2:53 there are people who live in their home their whole life, paid off their mortgage forever ago. Are on a fixed retirement income and then their property tax sky rockets and they can’t afford to pay it anymore and end up losing their home. That should not be happening in the USA.
